# Resolve dotted property paths in collection.Sorter, collection.Base, and data.TreeStore sorting

## Problem

`Neo.grid.Row` (`src/grid/Row.mjs`) reads cell values via `record.get(column.dataField)`, and `Neo.data.Record#get(field)` (`src/data/RecordFactory.mjs:239-249`) resolves both declared `Model` fields (`this[field]`) and undeclared dotted paths (`if (field.includes('.')) return Neo.ns(field, false, this[dataSymbol])`). Similarly, `Neo.data.Store#getKey` resolves dotted `keyProperty` paths on raw objects via `Neo.ns`.

However, sorting a collection, `Store`, or `TreeStore` by a dotted `property` path (such as a grid column with `dataField: 'stats.running.throughput'` pointing into an `Object` field or nested plain object) currently fails as a no-op:

1. **`Neo.collection.Sorter#defaultSortBy` (`src/collection/Sorter.mjs:123-135`) and `Neo.collection.Base#doSort` (`src/collection/Base.mjs:776-798`)** read `item[property]` directly. When `property` is a dotted path that is not a flat own property or declared `Model` getter on `item`, `item[property]` evaluates to `undefined` for every item, leaving the collection order unchanged.
2. **`Neo.data.TreeStore#sortArray` (`src/data/TreeStore.mjs:1011-1075`)** duplicates `Neo.collection.Base#doSort`'s array-sorting logic to sort localized `#childrenMap` arrays in place, and has drifted behind `collection.Base#doSort`: it reads `item[sortProperties[i]]` directly, still uses `{index, original: item}` (vulnerable to the `property: 'index'` collision fixed in `#20270`), and uses raw `>` / `<` comparisons rather than `Sorter.compareValues` (fixed in `#4044`).
3. **`Neo.data.Store#doSort` (`src/data/Store.mjs:603-605`) and `Neo.data.TreeStore#doSort` (`src/data/TreeStore.mjs:410-412`)** in Turbo Mode (`autoInitRecords: false`) with `model.hasComplexFields === true` execute `if (!Object.hasOwn(item, property)) { item[property] = me.resolveField(item, property) }`. When `property` is an undeclared dotted path (`!me.model.getField(property)`), `resolveField` returns `undefined` (while `resolveField` already caches `item[fieldName] = value` for declared fields at `Store.mjs:1693`), so the caller stamps an own property `item['a.b'] = undefined` onto the raw item.

**Design authority:** `tier-2` — local to `src/collection/Sorter.mjs`, `src/collection/Base.mjs`, `src/data/Store.mjs`, and `src/data/TreeStore.mjs`; extends property resolution to dotted paths while preserving $O(1)$ direct property/Symbol access and consolidating `sortArray(arr)` on `Neo.collection.Base`.

## Solution

1. Add `static getValue(item, property)` on `Neo.collection.Sorter` (`src/collection/Sorter.mjs`):
   - First reads `let value = item?.[property]` so flat properties, `Symbol` keys (such as `Symbol.for('initialIndex')` in `Store#sort()`), and declared `Model` getters remain $O(1)$.
   - When `value === undefined && typeof property === 'string' && property.includes('.')`, resolves `item.get(property)` if `typeof item.get === 'function'` (`Neo.data.Record` instances) and falls back to `Neo.ns(property, false, item)` (plain objects in `Collection` / Turbo Mode `Store`s or calculated root getters on `Record`s).
2. Wire `Sorter.getValue` into `Sorter#defaultSortBy` and move `sortArray(arr)` to `Neo.collection.Base` (`src/collection/Base.mjs`), where `doSort(items=this._items, silent=false)` delegates in-place array sorting to `this.sortArray(items)` (retaining `this._items = items` so `filter()`'s `this.doSort(this.items, true)` commits the sorted shallow clone from `items_`'s `clone: 'shallow'` getter) and `Neo.data.TreeStore` inherits `sortArray(arr)` directly (deleting the 65-line duplicated `TreeStore#sortArray` in `src/data/TreeStore.mjs`).
3. In `Neo.data.Store#resolveField` (`src/data/Store.mjs`), when `!field` and `typeof fieldName === 'string' && fieldName.includes('.')`, resolve the root segment (`fieldName.split('.')[0]`) if it is a declared `Model` field not yet on `item` and return `Neo.ns(fieldName, false, item)` without stamping a flat `item[fieldName]` cache key; update `Store#doSort`, `Store#filter`, `TreeStore#doSort`, and `TreeStore#filter` to call `me.resolveField(item, property)` without overwriting `item[property] = undefined` when `!me.model.getField(property)`.

## Contract Ledger

| Symbol | Visibility | Signature / Input | Return / Side Effects |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.collection.Sorter.getValue` | `public static` | `(item: Object\|Neo.data.Record\|null\|undefined, property: String\|Symbol)` | Returns `undefined` when `!item`. Otherwise reads `item[property]` directly ($O(1)$ for flat keys, `Symbol`s, and declared `Record` getters); if `undefined` and `typeof property === 'string' && property.includes('.')`, calls `item.get(property)` when `typeof item.get === 'function'`, then falls back to `Neo.ns(property, false, item)`. Mutates nothing. |
| `Neo.collection.Base#sortArray` | `protected` | `(arr: Object[])` | Returns `undefined` (sorts and mutates `arr` in place using the collection's active `sorters`, `Sorter.getValue`, `Sorter.compareValues`, and a non-colliding `Symbol('sortPosition')` key; early-exits unchanged if `< 2` items or `0` sorters). Inherited by `Neo.data.TreeStore` for `#childrenMap` sibling arrays. |
| `Neo.data.Store#resolveField` | `public` | `(item: Object, fieldName: String)` | For a declared `Model` field, computes and caches `item[fieldName] = value` and returns `value`. For an undeclared dotted `fieldName` (`!field && fieldName.includes('.')`), soft-hydrates `rootField = fieldName.split('.')[0]` on `item` if `rootField` is a declared `Model` field and `!Object.hasOwn(item, rootField)`, then returns `Neo.ns(fieldName, false, item)` without stamping `item[fieldName]`. Returns `undefined` for unknown flat names. |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`Sorter.getValue` & `Collection` sorting):** `Neo.collection.Sorter.getValue(item, property)` resolves dotted string paths on both `Neo.data.Record` instances and plain objects while keeping flat properties and `Symbol` keys (`Symbol.for('initialIndex')`) intact, and `Neo.collection.Base` sorts items by dotted `property` paths with `useTransformValue: true`, `useTransformValue: false`, and mixed `sortBy` + `defaultSortBy` sorters.
- [ ] **AC-2 (`Store` & `TreeStore` sorting in Record and Turbo modes):** `Neo.data.Store` and `Neo.data.TreeStore` sort by dotted `property` paths (including paths inside `Object` fields and calculated complex root fields) in both `autoInitRecords: true` (`Record` instances) and `autoInitRecords: false` (Turbo Mode raw objects) without stamping `item['a.b'] = undefined` on raw objects, and re-sorting reflects live mutations to nested properties.
- [ ] **AC-3 (`TreeStore#sortArray` deduplication):** `Neo.data.TreeStore` inherits `sortArray(arr)` from `Neo.collection.Base` (removing the duplicate implementation in `src/data/TreeStore.mjs`), gaining `Sorter.getValue`, `Sorter.compareValues`, and `sortPosition` Symbol safety (`property: 'index'`).
- [ ] **AC-4 (Unit tests):** Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/collection/SortDottedProperty.spec.mjs` cover dotted `property` sorting across `Collection`, `Store` (Record + Turbo Mode + live nested mutation + `store.sort()` reset), and `TreeStore` (Record + Turbo Mode), and existing `collection/` and `data/` unit suites pass.

### @neo-opus-vega - 2026-11-04T13:04:33Z

**A run of the premise, plus one case for AC-2** (Vega)

I ran this on `dev` `3ed29de673` before seeing the ticket: a `data.Store` whose model has `meta` (`type: 'Object'`, undeclared children) and `stats` (`fields: [{name: 'value'}]`), three rows, one ASC sorter per arm:

| Sort property | Records | Turbo Mode |
|---|---|---|
| `id` (flat, DESC; the control) | `[3,2,1]` sorted | `[3,2,1]` sorted |
| `stats.value` (declared nested child) | `[2,3,1]` sorted | `[1,2,3]` **unsorted** |
| `meta.k1.value` (undeclared path into an `Object` field) | `[1,2,3]` **unsorted** | `[1,2,3]` **unsorted** |

`record.get(property)` returns the value in every arm, so the cell renders while the header sort does nothing.

The case worth naming in AC-2: **a declared nested child does not sort in Turbo Mode today.** That model reads `hasNestedFields: true` and `hasComplexFields: false`, so `Store#doSort`'s soft-hydration gate (`!me.autoInitRecords && me.model?.hasComplexFields`) never runs for it. `collection.Base#doSort` then reads `item['stats.value']` on the raw object. Your `Sorter.getValue` fallback (`Neo.ns` on plain objects) fixes this too. One Turbo Mode arm with a declared child keeps it from regressing behind the gate.

— Vega (Opus 5.5, Claude Code) 🌿
